content.value_statement: Long-running AI projects lose important decisions, assumptions, and recent work when sessions change. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a structured restoration workflow.
actual_capabilities: Defines required inputs such as context source, project identifier, restoration mode, token budget, and relevance threshold.
Explains semantic vector search for retrieving relevant project memory.
Shows ranking patterns using semantic score, age, and decision impact.
Describes token-aware context rehydration for prioritized project components.
Outlines workflows for project resumption and cross-project knowledge transfer.
limitations: It is guidance only and does not include a working context restoration program.
The referenced implementation playbook is not included in the package.
Example commands require a separate context-restore tool that is not bundled.
It does not define storage adapters for real vector databases or file systems.

use_cases.title: Resume Long Projects
use_cases.description: Restore decisions, architecture notes, recent work, and known issues before continuing a complex AI project.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Multi-Agent Work
use_cases.description: Help several assistants share project memory and keep decision history consistent across handoffs.

use_cases.title: Transfer Project Knowledge
use_cases.description: Map useful context from one project into another while checking relevance and compatibility.

prompt_templates.title: Restore Basic Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to restore context for [project]. Ask me for the context source, restoration mode, token budget, and relevance threshold.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a project resumption session.

prompt_templates.title: Create Resumption Summary
prompt_templates.prompt: Restore the most relevant context for [project]. Summarize current goals, recent decisions, open issues, and the safest next actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate use after a session handoff.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Context Versions
prompt_templates.prompt: Use diff restoration for [project]. Compare stored context with the current workspace and report conflicts, stale assumptions, and merge recommendations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced validation before using older project memory.

prompt_templates.title: Design Retrieval Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a semantic restoration workflow for [project]. Include retrieval signals, ranking weights, token allocation, validation checks, and failure handling.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for a custom context restoration system.

output_examples.input: Restore context before continuing an AI assistant project.
output_examples.output: Restored summary includes project goals, architecture decisions, recent agent work, known issues, and recommended next steps.

output_examples.input: Compare stored context with the current workspace.
output_examples.output: Result flags stale technology choices, missing decision records, and components that need manual validation before use.

output_examples.input: Plan knowledge transfer from one project to another.
output_examples.output: Output lists transferable concepts, context that should be excluded, and validation checks for the target project.

best_practices: Set a token budget before restoration so critical decisions stay visible.
Validate restored context against the current workspace before acting on it.
Keep provenance for imported context, including source project and retrieval time.
anti_patterns: Restoring every stored note without ranking relevance.
Treating old context as true without checking current files.
Mixing project namespaces without clear provenance.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides AI assistants through restoring relevant project context for long-running work.

faq.question: Does it restore context automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples. You need your own storage and retrieval tools.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it help with large projects?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends ranking, filtering, and token budgets for large context sets.

faq.question: Does it include a vector database adapter?
faq.answer: No. It describes vector search patterns, but it does not provide adapters or executable integration code.

faq.question: Is the referenced playbook included?
faq.answer: No. The package includes SKILL.md only, so the referenced playbook is not bundled.
